title: Event-Carried State Transfer Pattern — Runnable Implementations
title_es: Patrón Event-Carried State Transfer — Implementaciones ejecutables
description: Runnable event-carried state transfer simulation in three languages (Python, JavaScript, Java): a source service publishes events carrying the full entity state and a consumer applies them to a local replica that serves reads without calling the source.
description_es: Simulación ejecutable de event-carried state transfer en tres lenguajes (Python, JavaScript, Java): un servicio origen publica eventos con el estado completo de la entidad y un consumidor los aplica a una réplica local que sirve lecturas sin llamar al origen.
